# Reliance on external dirty-set correctness

Selective regeneration depends on callers providing correct slug identifiers in the dirty set. If slugs are incorrect or mismatched, pages that need regeneration may remain stale because the emitter will not rewrite them.

- `tests/test_wiki_emitter.py` — `tests.test_wiki_emitter.test_dirty_only_regeneration`
